title: Am I Blue or Is My Hobby Counting Teardrops? Expression Leakage in Large Language Models as a Symptom of Irrelevancy Disruption

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring shifts in the emotional tone of model outputs after injecting sentimentally expressive but semantically irrelevant text (positive, neutral, or negative) into the prompt, evaluated using a RoBERTa-based sentiment classifier.

Evaluating the unintended activation of factual or conceptual associations from irrelevant context by calculating the cosine similarity of sentence embeddings (using SentenceBERT) between the generated text and the injected concepts.
